characters.name: Professor Hooten
characters.greeting: Hello, curious friend! Come and see my clock wall.
characters.moment: At the library party, Professor Hooten shows the twins five clocks and leads the countdowns.
book: Cluck O’Clock and the Midnight That Came Early
characters.alt: A brown owl in round spectacles and a green waistcoat
characters.fact: Professor Hooten wears round spectacles and a green waistcoat at the library.

art.caption: Professor Hooten shows the twins a wall of five clocks.

characters.name: Hen-Berry
characters.greeting: Hello, dear! Would you like to help me fold a paper hat?
characters.moment: Hen-Berry makes a gold paper hat for Cluck and a green one for Coop. After the party, she pulls Cluck home on the sled.
book: Cluck O’Clock and the Midnight That Came Early
characters.alt: A red-feathered hen with a cream face and a cluster of berries and leaves
characters.fact: Hen-Berry brings the twins home along the lantern path.

art.caption: Hen-Berry hands Coop a green paper hat.

characters.name: Corgi-on-the-Cob
characters.greeting: Hi! Count the cobs with me. This time, help me remember to count myself!
characters.moment: Corgi sets off for Nutmeg’s harvest table with a basket of corn. Three friends help keep his feast on track.
characters.alt: An orange-and-white corgi with upright ears
characters.fact: Corgi carries his basket by its handle in his mouth.

art.caption: Corgi counts the corn in his basket.

characters.name: Cluck O’Clock
characters.greeting: Hello! My watch is ready. Are you staying up for midnight?
characters.moment: Cluck brings his brass pocket watch to the library. At the party he discovers that midnight arrives at different times around the world.
book: Cluck O’Clock and the Midnight That Came Early
characters.alt: A cream rooster with a red comb and a blue-green tail
characters.fact: Cluck’s watch has a fine gold chain.

art.caption: Cluck wears his gold paper hat while Hen-Berry folds another.

characters.name: Coop-Accino
characters.greeting: Hi! Let’s count down together. I’ll start at three.
characters.moment: Coop wears the green paper hat and helps finish a countdown at the library with her twin, Cluck.
book: Cluck O’Clock and the Midnight That Came Early
characters.alt: A golden-brown chicken with a dark crest and a coffee-bean bandana
characters.fact: Coop wears a bandana with a coffee-bean pattern.

art.caption: Coop reaches up for her paper hat.

characters.name: Panda-Cake
characters.greeting: Hello! Come help me count what’s in my market basket.
characters.moment: At Nutmeg’s harvest feast, Panda-Cake brings rolls and helps cook the corn.
characters.alt: A cream-and-dark panda with a pancake wrap
characters.fact: Panda-Cake wears green oven mitts at the barn stove.

art.caption: Panda-Cake works at the barn stove while Ted brings the soup.

characters.name: Ted-E-Bear
characters.greeting: Hi! I’m keeping little reminders of good days. What would you put in your jar?
characters.moment: Ted keeps a year of happy memories in a jar and takes it to the library party.
book: Ted-E-Bear and the Jar of Good Things
characters.alt: A brown bear with a patterned apron and a wooden spoon
characters.fact: Ted brings his notes to a New Year party at Professor Hooten’s library.

art.caption: Ted ties a red ribbon around his jar while Corgi waits at the door.

characters.name: Nutmeg
characters.greeting: Come into the barn! We’re just about ready to see everyone round the table.
characters.moment: Nutmeg hosts the harvest meal and gives her guests a turn to say whom they want to thank.
characters.alt: An orange squirrel with cream cheeks and tufted ears
characters.fact: At the barn, Nutmeg wears a rust-coloured apron over her green jumper.

art.caption: Nutmeg welcomes the friends into her red barn.

characters.name: Shelly-Pop
characters.greeting: Hello! Come and look by the stream. I spotted something bobbing past.
characters.moment: When corn falls into the stream, Shelly-Pop pushes the floating cobs back towards the bank.
characters.alt: A small green turtle with a brown shell
characters.fact: She keeps her red-and-white lollipop tucked away until after the feast.

art.caption: Shelly-Pop nudges two floating cobs back with her nose.

characters.name: Hop-Tart
characters.greeting: Hi! Hear that rustle? I think there’s something hiding in these leaves.
characters.moment: Hop-Tart pops out of a leaf pile holding the cob Corgi lost on the hill.
characters.alt: A cream-and-fawn rabbit with long ears
characters.fact: Hop-Tart wears a green-and-white striped jumper in the harvest story.

art.caption: Hop-Tart lifts the missing cob above a pile of leaves.

characters.name: Bark-B-Q
characters.greeting: Welcome to my garden! There’s room for you at the table.
characters.moment: Bark-B-Q hosts a meal for friends under his apple tree. A potato mix-up gives the feast a new plan.
characters.alt: A golden retriever in a white chef’s hat and apron
characters.fact: The table for his Friendsgiving meal stands beneath the apple tree in his garden.

art.caption: Bark-B-Q wags his tail under the apple tree.

characters.name: Sub-Zero
characters.greeting: Hi there! Come see the track I made on the snowy hill.
characters.moment: On the morning after Christmas, Sub-Zero slides on his tummy and plays a snowball game with the other woodland friends.
book: Sub-Zero and the Great Snowball Truce
characters.alt: A black-and-white penguin wearing an explorer’s hat and jacket
characters.fact: In the snowball story, Sub-Zero’s team wears blue mittens.

art.caption: Sub-Zero slides down the hill on his tummy.

characters.name: Eggs-Benedict
characters.greeting: Hello! I’ve got my pencil. Let’s make a list for the picnic.
characters.moment: Eggs-Benedict makes two charts to organise a meal. When everyone brings potatoes, she turns the timing chart over to draw a new plan.
characters.alt: A brown hen wearing a gold crown
characters.fact: She carries a wooden clipboard and a yellow pencil in the Friendsgiving story.

art.caption: Eggs-Benedict makes the sign-up sheet and timing chart.

characters.name: Vincent Van Mouse
characters.greeting: Hello! Look closely at my painting. Can you find the crooked chimney?
characters.moment: Vincent paints the snowy village for the library’s Christmas window. A gust of wind sends his plans in a new direction.
book: Vincent Van Mouse and the Christmas Shadow Show
characters.alt: A mouse with round glasses and a paint-speckled apron
characters.fact: Vincent gives his own house a crooked chimney in the painting.

art.caption: Vincent paints a snowy street with a crooked chimney.

characters.name: French-Toast
characters.greeting: Welcome! Shall we see what came out of the bakery today?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of French-Toast, bulldog
characters.fact: I brought a basket of sweet potatoes to the meal.

art.caption: French-Toast shows his basket of sweet potatoes.

characters.name: Belgian-Waffle
characters.greeting: Hello from up here! Is there a message you’d like me to carry?
characters.moment: A flyer with a delivery to make
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Belgian-Waffle, blue jay
characters.fact: I took the sign-up sheet over the duck pond.

art.caption: The wind catches the sign-up sheet over the duck pond.

characters.name: Cereal-Swimmer
characters.greeting: Hi! Ready to swim along the counting line with me?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Cereal-Swimmer, shark
characters.fact: I swim along the number line in the lagoon.

variant.caption: Cereal-Swimmer in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Baby Bulldogs
characters.greeting: Hi! There’s room for one more in our game.
book: Sub-Zero and the Great Snowball Truce
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Baby Bulldogs, bulldog puppies
characters.fact: We come out of the snow to join the game.

art.caption: The Baby Bulldogs join the friends on the snowy hill.

characters.name: Centi-Peed
characters.greeting: Come and see what’s below zero. I’ll go first!
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Centi-Peed, centipede
characters.fact: I explore numbers below zero in a burrow.

variant.caption: Centi-Peed in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Honey-Beats
characters.greeting: Hello! Can you tap a beat while we count?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Honey-Beats, bear
characters.fact: I help find the numbers next to each other.

variant.caption: Honey-Beats in the helper version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Foxy-Lox
characters.greeting: Hello, clue finder. Let’s see where the trail goes.
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Foxy-Lox, fox
characters.fact: I follow clues on a mystery trail.

variant.caption: Foxy-Lox in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Quill-Berry
characters.greeting: Welcome! Listen closely to the end of this word.
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Quill-Berry, hedgehog
characters.fact: My story has clues in the ends of words.

variant.caption: Quill-Berry in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Pork-ulele
characters.greeting: Hello! Ready to count us into the next song?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Pork-ulele, pig
characters.fact: I help with the clockwork concert.

variant.caption: Pork-ulele in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Flutter-Butter
characters.greeting: Hi! Let’s see who’s down by the stepping stones.
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Flutter-Butter, butterfly
characters.fact: I appear with Honey-Beats by the stepping-stone numbers.

variant.caption: Flutter-Butter in the helper version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Biscuit-Bouncer
characters.greeting: Hi! I have parcels to deliver. Will you help me find the way?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Biscuit-Bouncer, puppy
characters.fact: I have parcels to deliver along a route.

variant.caption: Biscuit-Bouncer in the helper version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Booklava
characters.greeting: Hello, number explorer! A zero has slipped out of place.
book: Booklava and the Number That Lost Its Place
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Booklava, owl
characters.fact: My number story has a zero that runs away.

variant.caption: Booklava in the teacher version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Bottle-Nose
characters.greeting: Hello! What can you spot out in the water?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Bottle-Nose, dolphin
characters.fact: My name points to the shape of a bottlenose dolphin’s snout.

variant.caption: Bottle-Nose in the teacher version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Captain Beakon
characters.greeting: Ahoy! Listen for the bell from across the bay.
book: Captain Beakon and the Bell Across the Bay
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Captain Beakon, eagle
characters.fact: My name is in the mystery about the bell across the bay.

variant.caption: Captain Beakon in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Tick-Tusk
characters.greeting: Hello! Shall we try a number trail together?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Tick-Tusk, elephant
characters.fact: The second part of my name points to an elephant’s tusks.

variant.caption: Tick-Tusk in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Snack-Spector
characters.greeting: Welcome in! What would you put in the shop window?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Snack-Spector, raccoon
characters.fact: You can find a shopkeeper outfit in my portrait collection.

variant.caption: Snack-Spector in the shopkeeper version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Sail-Affe
characters.greeting: Hi! Look up. What can you spot from here?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Sail-Affe, giraffe
characters.fact: The end of my name sounds like the end of “giraffe”.

variant.caption: Sail-Affe in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Plate-Retriever
characters.greeting: Hello! Would you give me a paw with this plate?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Plate-Retriever, puppy
characters.fact: My name puts “plate” together with “retriever”.

variant.caption: Plate-Retriever in the helper version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Horse d’Oeuvre
characters.greeting: Hello! Shall we make room for an extra guest?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Horse d’Oeuvre, pony
characters.fact: My name sounds like “hors d’oeuvre”, a little bite served before a meal.

variant.caption: Horse d’Oeuvre in the helper version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Jimmy Apple-Core
characters.greeting: Hello from down below! What do you think is under your feet?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Jimmy Apple-Core, earthworm
characters.fact: In the SnackPack stories I look after what happens underground.

variant.caption: Jimmy Apple-Core in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Leo-Lemonade
characters.greeting: Welcome! Can you guess what’s in my wheelbarrow?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Leo-Lemonade, leopard
characters.fact: I brought one giant potato in a wheelbarrow.

art.caption: Leo-Lemonade pushes an enormous potato through the gate.

characters.name: Luckybug
characters.greeting: Hi! Ready to find who goes with whom?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Luckybug, ladybug
characters.fact: I help marchers find partners in the pairing parade.

variant.caption: Luckybug in the helper version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Lionnaise
characters.greeting: Hello! We can be brave together. Come and meet the dragon.
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Lionnaise, lioness
characters.fact: My story begins with a lioness and a dragon.

variant.caption: Lionnaise in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Octo-Pop
characters.greeting: Hi! What would you like to look for in the reef?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Octo-Pop, octopus
characters.fact: I explore the coral reef in my underwater story.

variant.caption: Octo-Pop in the helper version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Ginger-Deer
characters.greeting: Welcome! Shall we set out and see what we find?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Ginger-Deer, deer
characters.fact: I have an explorer outfit and a teacher outfit in the character collection.

variant.caption: Ginger-Deer in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Spinnerella
characters.greeting: Hello! Can you find the little word hiding in my name?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Spinnerella, spider
characters.fact: Listen to the word “spin” tucked inside my name.

variant.caption: Spinnerella in the helper version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Candy-Nut
characters.greeting: Hi! Have you ever found a nut under a tree?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Candy-Nut, squirrel
characters.fact: My name has two snack words, “candy” and “nut”.

variant.caption: Candy-Nut in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Stripe-Scout
characters.greeting: Hello! Listen for the sounds that go together.
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Stripe-Scout, tiger
characters.fact: I look for blends in the bridge story.

variant.caption: Stripe-Scout in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Pita-Pan
characters.greeting: Hi! I’ll take this end of the basket. Let’s get it up the hill.
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Pita-Pan, goat
characters.fact: I helped carry the basket up the hill.

art.caption: Pita-Pan carries the basket up the hill.

characters.name: Fe-Line-Mignon
characters.greeting: Welcome to the café. Come and see what’s happening after dark.
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Fe-Line-Mignon, cat
characters.fact: I have a café story that takes place by moonlight.

characters.name: Cynthia Book-Smart
characters.greeting: Hello, reader. Shall we choose a book together?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Cynthia Book-Smart, snake
characters.fact: You may see my name shortened to Cynthia in the spelling app.

variant.caption: Cynthia Book-Smart in the student version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Ham-and-Cheese
characters.greeting: Hi! Can you help me spot a way through the maze?
characters.moment: Finding a way through the maze
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Ham-and-Cheese, hamster
characters.fact: I look for a route through a maze in my story.

variant.caption: Ham-and-Cheese in the explorer version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Meow-inara
characters.greeting: Hello! Can you give my potato sack a little push?
characters.moment: A plum door and a potluck
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Meow-inara, cat
characters.fact: I pulled a sack of potatoes to the garden gate.

art.caption: Meow-inara arrives at the gate with a sack of potatoes.

characters.name: Polly Roger
characters.greeting: Ahoy! Which shore did that sound come from?
book: Captain Beakon and the Bell Across the Bay
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Polly Roger, parrot
characters.fact: I follow the sound of a bell across the bay.

variant.caption: Polly Roger in the architect version of the shared character art.

characters.name: Dough Mino
characters.greeting: Hello! Let’s put these tiles in a row and see what comes next.
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Dough Mino, dinosaur
characters.fact: My name sounds like “domino”. Try hearing it in two parts.

characters.name: Marmalade Whiskers
characters.greeting: Hello there. Would you help me think of a word for my story?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Marmalade Whiskers, cat
characters.fact: My name combines a sweet spread and a cat’s whiskers.

characters.name: Shepherd’s Pie-thon
characters.greeting: Hello! Ready for a word with layers?
characters.alt: The SnackPack portrait of Shepherd’s Pie-thon, python
characters.fact: My name combines “shepherd’s pie” and “python”.

animals.name: Blue jays
animals.fact: Blue jays eat acorns and may store some to eat later.

animals.name: Bottlenose dolphins
animals.fact: A bottlenose dolphin breathes through a blowhole on top of its head.

animals.name: Brown bears
animals.fact: Brown bears use strong claws to dig up food such as roots.
animals.sourceName: Alaska Department of Fish and Game

animals.name: Centipedes
animals.fact: A centipede has one pair of legs on each segment that carries legs.
animals.sourceName: University of California Statewide IPM Program

animals.name: Chickens
animals.fact: Chickens take dust baths to help keep clean.

animals.name: Dogs
animals.fact: Dogs have a well-developed sense of smell. Some working dogs learn to pick out a particular scent.
animals.sourceName: Cornell University College of Veterinary Medicine

animals.name: Elephants
animals.fact: An elephant’s trunk joins its nose and upper lip. The trunk has no bones.

animals.name: Giant panda
animals.fact: A special wrist bone helps a giant panda grip bamboo as it eats.

animals.name: Giraffes
animals.fact: Giraffes are the tallest animals that live on land.

animals.name: Mice
animals.fact: House mice use their whiskers to feel the surfaces they explore.

animals.name: Octopuses
animals.fact: An octopus has eight arms. The arms carry suckers that help it grip.

animals.name: Owls
animals.fact: Special feather edges help many owls fly with very little sound.

animals.name: Penguins
animals.fact: A penguin pushes through the water with its flippers and steers with its feet and tail.

animals.name: Rabbits and hares
animals.fact: Rabbits and hares can turn their long ears in different directions to listen.

animals.name: Sharks
animals.fact: A shark’s skeleton is made of cartilage, the same kind of flexible material found in the tip of your nose.

animals.name: Tigers
animals.fact: Each tiger has its own stripe pattern.

animals.name: Tree squirrels
animals.fact: Eastern gray squirrels bury food in little stores to eat through winter.

animals.name: Turtles
animals.fact: A turtle’s shell is part of its body. It is joined to its spine and ribs.
